QuestInfo.name: [Gold Beach] Housekeeping!
QuestInfo.1: Prevent #o3401002# monsters from messing up any more rooms. #o3401002# monsters are usually at #m120041000#, which can be accessed by taking the portal to the east of #m120040000#.
QuestInfo.2: Now that you took care of those troublemaker #o3401002# monsters, let everyone know you're actually a guest!

0.0: You are an adequate employee. I have decided not to fire you.\r\n#L0##bI don't really work here--\n#k
0.1: Officially, I know, but we'll get to the paperwork when there's time.\r\n#L0##bThis is the worst vacation ever.#l\n#k
0.2: Work is never a vacation, kid. Now I am going to go and tend to a gaggle of fatheaded investors who have had far too much sun, and you are going to take care of #b#o3401002##k monsters.

yes.0: My staff has cleaned every room in this gaudy rat-trap we call a resort, but the local wildlife has made it a habit of undoing all of our work. I want you to go to #e#m120041000##n and a do a little housekeeping on the monsters. Just so we're clear, that means I want you to destroy them.

no.0: I am not here to wait for you. Hurry up.

1.0: Did you take care of 40 #o3401002# monsters?

yes.0: You have helped this resort. I don't know whether I should praise you, or fire you.

mob.0: Did my mustache interrupt your lip-reading abilities? Go to #m120041000# and take care of 40 #o3401002# monsters. You can reach #m120041000# by taking the eastern portal in #m120040000#.
